resources.string: Recent messages in your inbox are downloaded after each check, so they open at once, even offline. Never on Battery Saver or when storage is low. Pictures from the web are not downloaded.
Tell me about new messages in my inboxes
Notifications are turned off for Mailcrane in your phone’s settings
Notify within a minute of new mail by keeping a connection open. Uses more battery and shows a permanent notification. When off, Mailcrane checks about every 15 minutes.
Tap to see why and how to turn it off for Mailcrane
Battery optimisation is off for Mailcrane

Android saves battery by pausing apps in the background. While Mailcrane is paused, its connection to your mail server can drop, and new mail notifications may come many minutes late.
To get notified within a minute, turn off battery optimisation for Mailcrane: on the next screen, choose “All apps”, find Mailcrane and select “Don’t optimise” (the wording differs between phones).
Some phones have a further setting of their own, often called “Allow background activity” or “Auto-launch”, in the app’s battery settings. Turn that on too if notifications still come late.
Mailcrane uses the connection only to wait for new mail, so the extra battery use is small.
Your phone has no battery optimisation screen Mailcrane can open. Look for Mailcrane under Settings → Apps → Battery.
